item.description: An Illinois truck driver had serious injuries in a crash Tuesday evening in Livingston County. State Troopers investigated the crash that occurred at about 8:00 pm on US 36, a mile east of Chillicothe. item.title: Portion Of Route V Closed For Emergency Culvert Replacement
item.description: A portion of Route V, east of Chillicothe, is closed today for an emergency culvert replacement. The Missouri Department of Transportation has closed Livingston County Route V from County Road 232 to County Road 230 until 4 p.m. Motorists will need to find an alternate route during the closure.
